subject: STABLE texture-opus #6: P2 format gates = Mali arch9 table (79 formats draw on host vs 7+ASTC before) + Mali-true profile (ETC2/EAC, ASTC HDR, RG8 sRGB) + YCbCr fast path; HEAVY RELEASE
